purpose: Read only the frozen G9_DT2 failure-step numerical state needed to distinguish algebraic pressure-residual localization from a discrete projection-operator or boundary mismatch. This audit does not compute or classify physical observables.

config.path: 90_候选工作区/current/07_D3跨网格时间步响应诊断/generated_configs/G9_DT2.json

frozen_partial.path: 90_候选工作区/current/07_D3跨网格时间步响应诊断/artifacts/r1/runs/cases/G9_DT2/partial.npz

result_blindness.rule: Commit and push this contract before the audit implementation loads any whitelisted numeric member. Any result-dependent change to equations, thresholds, regions, or adjudication invalidates the audit.

spatial_snapshot.meaning: The state and grid arrays are the single final failure-step snapshot only.

archive_access.integrity: Verify frozen size and SHA-256 before and after reading; abort on drift. Record the exact accessed-member list in the compact result.

independent_discrete_reconstruction.implementation_rule: Assemble the diagnostic divergence, face coefficients, pressure matrix, residual, connectivity, and flux closure independently in the candidate audit. Do not call a formal projection implementation as the sole calculation.
independent_discrete_reconstruction.velocity_correction: u_plus = u_star - dt * beta * G p
independent_discrete_reconstruction.predictor_reconstruction: u_star_rec = u_plus + dt * beta * G p
independent_discrete_reconstruction.matrix: A = -V * D_h * beta * G; active-cell ordering is C-order and A is assembled as a symmetric positive-definite matrix
independent_discrete_reconstruction.formal_boundary_identity: Internal faces are open only between two active cells; side and bottom exterior faces are closed; the top exterior face is open for an active top cell and uses a half-cell pressure distance.

spatial_hotspot_audit.max_cell: Lexicographically first C-order active cell attaining max(abs(d_plus)).
spatial_hotspot_audit.hot_component: Six-neighbour connected component of hot_cells containing max_cell.
spatial_hotspot_audit.expanded_region: Hot-component index bounding box expanded by two cells in every axis and clipped to the domain.
spatial_hotspot_audit.interface_gradients: Use grid-spacing-aware finite differences for grad(phi); grad(rho) follows the frozen affine density law. Report compact maxima, overlap counts, distances, indices, and bounding boxes only.
spatial_hotspot_audit.collocation: For a proposed explanatory field q, argmax(abs(q)) must lie in the d_plus max-cell hot component.

hypotheses.H_A: Algebraic residual localization: the pressure solver's L2-relative stopping evidence permits an L-infinity divergence hotspot even though the discrete correction operator is internally consistent.
hypotheses.H_B: Discrete operator or boundary mismatch: the saved corrected velocity, pressure, density, masks, and independently reconstructed matrix-gradient-divergence identity leave a localized operator defect.
hypotheses.H_C: Saved-state versus diagnostic alignment or archive-semantics mismatch: recomputed max(abs(d_plus)) cannot reproduce the frozen archived final divergence scalar.

adjudication.H_A_support: Archived scalar reproduces; q=d_alg reaches both 0.90 explained-fraction gates; q collocates; and e_op is at rounding scale.
adjudication.H_B_support: Archived scalar reproduces; q=e_op reaches both 0.90 explained-fraction gates; and q collocates.
adjudication.H_C_support: Archived scalar reproduction fails the frozen tolerance. H_C is reported as a hypothesis flag, but it does not authorize a fix.
adjudication.tie_or_ambiguity: If neither H_A nor H_B exclusively satisfies every required gate, return the unidentified terminal. Do not tune regions or thresholds.

outputs.content_rule: Compact scalar metrics, integer indices, counts, labels, and bounding boxes only; no full fields and no physical-observable values.

hard_stops: No HF3D dynamic step or archive resume.
No modification of 01_最终理论, 02_模拟程序, or AGENTS.md.
No solver fix in the same audit round.
Stop at one frozen terminal status and obtain independent review before any candidate fix.
